name: Tricia O'Kelley
bio: Patricia Beth O'Kelley (born September 26, 1968) is an American actress and producer, best recognized as Marly Ehrhardt on the CBS sitcom The New Adventures of Old Christine (2006–10), her recurring role as Nicole Leahy on The WB television series Gilmore Girls (2003–04), Jade Huntington Snell on Saved By the Bell (2020), as well as the lead role of Sylvia in the independent comedy film Weather Girl (2009), of which she also was producer.
